[head=3][color=crimson]These rules are presented in an arbitrary order with equal priority.[break]Game administrators may act on judgements not laid out by the rules.[/color][/head]
### 0. You must be 18 years or older to participate in Pinwheel Anyone found to be below the age of admission will be summarily banned. [break]This server deals in roleplay experiences unsuitable for minors.
### 1. Make an effort to roleplay This server exists to provide a roleplay experience alongside its gameplay. [break]While in control of a character, stay in character, without exception. [break]While in control of a silicon, follow your sillicon laws. [break]OOC, LOOC, and Dead chat are explicitly out-of-character.
### 2. Do not abuse the game Do not abuse bugs, modified clients, or external tools to get an advantage.
### 3. Play in good faith Follow the social contract. Don't play just to be a nuisance to others. [break]Bigotry will not be harbored.
